utme_subjects: English Language, Literature in English, Government or History plus any other Arts or Social Science subject
utme_requirements: Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English, Government or History plus any other two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects
direct_entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes chosen from Arts or Social Science subjects. UTME requirements, plus acceptable passes at Advanced Level or at the Higher Grade Teachers' Certificate (TC II) or its equivalent in two subjects relevant to the proposed degree course. UTME requirements plus National Diploma (ND) at Lower Credit level.
remarks: ABU accepts five (5) O'level credit passes in Arts and/or Social Science subjects including English Language, and Literature-in-English to include Government or History.

ABUJA requires five (5) credit passes at SSCE/GCE O'Level or their equivalent at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language and Literature-in-English. In addition, candidate must have credit in three other Arts or Social Science subjects including Government/History or Economics. Accepts HND (Lower Credit) in Law related disciplines or ND (Lower Credit) in Law related disciplines (plus six credit passes at not more than two sittings). Two (2) 'A' level passes or three (3) NCE at merit level in Arts or Social Science subjects.

ABUAD requires Five (5) 'O' level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Biology/Agricultural Science and any other two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects. UTME: English Language, Literature in English and any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects.

AKSU requires five (5) credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts subjects or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: IJMB/Cambridge GCE 'A' Level – Two passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR NCE with two merit passes in relevant subjects. HND (Lower Credit) or ND (Lower Credit) plus NCE (merit) in relevant subjects.

AAUA accepts Five 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English plus three other Arts and Social Science subjects. Two 'A' Level passes in Arts subjects or ND or HND (Lower Credit) in Law related disciplines.

ABSU requires Five (5) O'Level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Mathematics, Literature in English and two (2) other Arts or Social Science subjects including Government or History, Christian Religious Knowledge or Islamic Studies. OR NCE/ND (Merit or Lower Credit) in Law or related field plus five (5) O'Level credits as stated above. OR Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects plus five (5) O'Level credits as stated above.

AUGUSTINE requires five (5) credit level passes including English Language, Literature in English and any other three (3) subjects from Arts or Social Science. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in relevant Arts or Social Science subjects or Ordinary National Diploma (OND) with Lower Credit in Law related discipline.

BABCOCK accepts Five (5) credit passes at WASC/SSCE O' level at not more than two sittings to include English Language, Literature in English, and any three (3) Social Science subjects. Two 'A' level passes in relevant subject plus five WASC/SSCE O' level credit passes. HND or ND (lower credit) plus WASC/SSCE O' level five credit passes. NCE in relevant subject at merit level plus five WASC/SSCE credit passes.

BASU requires Five credit passes at O'Level (WAEC/NECO/NABTEB) at a maximum of two sittings including English Language, Literature in English and any other three Arts/Social Science subjects (Mathematics may be accepted in lieu of an Arts/Social Science subject). Direct Entry: Two A'Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects. OR HND/ND Lower Credit plus O'Level requirements as stated above OR NCE with at least Merit passes plus O'Level requirements.
BELLS requires five (5) credit passes including English Language, Literature-in-English and any three other Arts and/or Social Science subjects.

BENIN accepts credit passes in five (5) subjects including English Language and four (4) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Direct Entry: Two (2) A' Level passes including Arts or Social Science subjects. OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law and Related Courses.

BENUE accepts Five (5) credit passes in WAEC, NECO or NABTEB at not more than two sittings including English Language, Literature in English plus three other Arts/Social Science subjects including Government or History. UTME subjects: Use of English, Literature in English, Government or History plus one other Arts or Social Science subject. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects.

BOWEN requires Five (5) O' Level credit passes in English Language, Literature in English, Government or History and any other two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. UTME: English, Literature in English, Government/History plus any other subject. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law or related field OR NCE (Merit) in relevant subject.

CALEB requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Literature in English and any three other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects OR Diploma in Law OR NCE Merit in relevant subject.

CALABAR requires five (5) O'Level credit passes at SSCE or its equivalent obtained at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature-in-English, and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes at the Advanced Level. HND at Lower Credit in Law related courses. ND at Upper Credit in Law related courses.

CARITAS requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in SSCE or equivalent, obtained at not more than two (2) sittings, including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts/Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects. ND/HND Lower Credit in Law or related course. NCE merit in relevant subjects.

CETEP requires five (5) credit passes at O'Level in not more than two sittings to include English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or NCE at merit level in relevant subjects or OND/HND (Lower Credit).

CLIFFORD requires Five (5) O' level credits obtained in one or two sittings including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects plus O' level requirements OR ND (Lower Credit) or HND (Lower Credit) in Law or related subjects plus O' level requirements OR NCE (Merit) in relevant subjects plus O' level requirements.

COVENANT requires five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English, Government, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes or its equivalent in Arts or Social Science subjects, NCE (merit level) in Education and Arts or Social Science, ND/HND (Lower credit) in Law.

CRUTECH requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings in WAEC/NECO/NABTEB or equivalent to include English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

DELTA requires Five (5) O'Level credit passes obtained at one sitting or at most two sittings including English Language and Literature-in-English and any three subjects from Arts or Social Science. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. ND/HND (Lower Credit) in any related programme with Five (5) O' level requirements.

DELSU requires five (5) O'Level credit passes in relevant subjects including English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND or HND at lower credit in Law and related disciplines.

EBSU accepts Five (5) SSCE credit passes or its equivalent at not more than two (2) sittings, including English Language, Literature in English and other relevant subjects to include Government/History. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. ND or HND at Lower Credit in Law.

EKSU requires five (5) credit passes at the Senior Secondary School Certificate (SSC) or its equivalent including English Language, Literature in English, plus three (3) other Arts/Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects OR HND (Lower Credit) in Law OR ND (Lower Credit) in Law.

ENUGU (ESUT) requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes at the WASC, NECO, NABTEB or GCE at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature in English and three other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Sciences subjects or HND/ND at lower credit in Law and related courses.

FOUNTUNI requires Five (5) credit level passes in SSCE/WAEC/NECO or equivalent obtained at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) other subjects in Arts or Social Sciences. UTME: English Language, Literature in English plus any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes at Advanced Level in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law or related discipline OR NCE (Merit) in relevant subject.

GOUU requires five (5) credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Sciences subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Sciences subjects or NCE (merit) in relevant subjects or ND/HND at lower credit in Law and related fields.

GREGORY requires Five (5) SSCE credit passes or its equivalent at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature-in-English, and three other Arts/Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. HND/ND (Lower Credit) in Law or related discipline.

GOMBE requires Five (5) O'level credit passes in Arts and/or Social Science subjects to include English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or HND/ND (Lower Credit) in Law.

IBADAN accepts Five (5) O'Level credit passes at the SSCE, GCE, NECO, NABTEB or equivalent at NOT more than TWO (2) sittings. The subjects must include English Language, Literature-in-English, and three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' Level passes from Arts or Social Science subjects OR HND at Lower Credit level obtained from a recognized institution.

IGBINEDION requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) subjects from Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

ILORIN requires Five credit passes in Arts or Social Science subjects at the Senior School Certificate (SSC) or its equivalent including English Language, Literature-in-English, Government and/or History. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND at Lower Credit in Law or related disciplines.

IMSU requires five (5) credit passes in SSCE/GCE or NECO including English Language, Literature-in-English, Government or History and two other Arts/Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings. Direct Entry: Two (2) passes at 'A' level or its equivalent in Arts/Social Science. OR ND in Law with at least Lower Credit OR HND in Law with Lower Credit.

JOS requires Five (5) credit passes at the O'Level or its equivalent (not more than two sittings) including English Language, Literature in English, and at least three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Science. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects.

KASU requires five (5) credit passes at one sitting or six (6) at two sittings in SSCE, GCE or its equivalent including English Language, Literature-in-English, Government, and two other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or NCE merit level in relevant subjects or ND/HND Lower Credit in Law.

KSU requires five (5) O'Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other subjects from Arts and Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. UTME: English Language, Literature in English, Government/History plus any other Arts or Social Science subject. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in relevant Arts/Social Science subjects. ND Lower Credit/HND Lower Credit in Law.

KWASU requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes at one or two sittings to include English Language, Literature in English, Government and any two other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in relevant Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

LAGOS requires five (5) O' Level credit passes at the WASSCE or NECO or NABTEB at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature in English plus three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Sciences subjects.

LEAD-CITY requires five (5) O'level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law or NCE (Merit level) in relevant subjects.

MADONNA requires Five (5) credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry candidates must possess in addition to the UTME requirements two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND at Lower Credit in Law or related disciplines.

MAIDUGURI requires Five (5) credit level passes at the O'Level (SSCE/WAEC/NECO/GCE) obtained at not more than two (2) sittings in English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law and related programmes.

MCU requires five (5) O'Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law. NCE (Merit) in relevant subjects.

MERINEWS requires Five (5) O'Level credit passes in English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects. ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law. NCE (Merit) in relevant subjects.

MOUNTOP requires five (5) credit passes at O' level/WAEC/NECO/NABTEB in relevant subjects including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two sittings. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law or NCE (Merit) in relevant subjects.

NSUK requires five credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' level passes in relevant Arts or Social Science subjects or ND (Lower Credit) in Law and related disciplines.

NIGER (NDU) requires five (5) O' Level credit passes in WAEC/NECO/NABTEB obtained at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature-in-English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

NDA requires Five (5) SSCE credit passes or equivalent obtained at not more than two (2) sittings in English Language, Mathematics, and three other subjects relevant to the course of study from Arts or Social Sciences. Direct Entry: In addition to O'Level requirements, candidates must possess any of the following: Two (2) GCE 'A' Level passes or equivalent in relevant Arts or Social Science subjects or NCE obtained at merit level in relevant subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

OAU requires five (5) O' level credit passes which must include English Language, Literature in English, Government/History/CRS/IRS and any two (2) Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects.

OBAFEMI (OOU) requires five (5) SSCE credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature-in-English and any three (3) other Arts/Social Science subjects. UTME: English Language, Literature-in-English, Government or History and any other Arts or Social Science subject. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

OSUSTECH requires five (5) O'level credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and any three Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or HND/ND (Lower Credit) in Law.

PAMO requires five (5) credit passes at O'Level including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science or ND/HND at lower credit in Law or Law related fields.

PAU requires Five (5) credit passes at SSCE/GCE obtained at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language, Literature in English and any three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law or NCE Merit in relevant subjects.

PAUL (PU) requires five (5) O'Level credit passes at SSCE or equivalent obtained at not more than two sittings to include English Language, Literature-in-English and three other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

PLASU requires five (5) credit passes at O'Level including English Language, Literature-in-English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

RENAISSANCE requires five (5) credit passes at O'Level (WAEC/NECO) in not more than two sittings to include English Language, Literature-in-English and any three Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law and related disciplines.

REDEEMERS requires Five (5) SSCE Credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature in English and any three other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

RSUST requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in SSCE/GCE/NECO/NABTEB obtained at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

TANSIAN requires five (5) O'Level credit passes including English Language, Literature in English and three (3) Arts or Social Science subjects at not more than two (2) sittings. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects. ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law. NCE (Merit) in relevant subjects.

UDU requires Five (5) O' level credit passes obtained at one or two sittings including English Language, Literature-in-English and any three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

UNN accepts Five (5) credit passes at O'Level to include English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. UTME: English Language, Literature in English, Government/History plus any other Arts or Social Science subject. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

UNIJOS (JOS) requires Five (5) credit passes at the O'Level or its equivalent (not more than two sittings) including English Language, Literature in English, and at least three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Science. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects.

UNIMAID requires Five (5) credit level passes at the O'Level (SSCE/WAEC/NECO/GCE) obtained at not more than two (2) sittings in English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other Arts or Social Science subjects. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law and related programmes.

UNIUYO requires five (5) O'Level credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Sciences subjects or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

UNILAG requires five (5) O' Level credit passes at the WASSCE or NECO or NABTEB at not more than two (2) sittings including English Language, Literature in English plus three (3) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Sciences subjects.

UNILORIN requires Five credit passes in Arts or Social Science subjects at the Senior School Certificate (SSC) or its equivalent including English Language, Literature-in-English, Government and/or History. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects OR ND/HND at Lower Credit in Law or related disciplines.

UNIPORT requires five (5) O'level credit passes to include English Language, Literature in English and at least three (3) other subjects chosen from Arts and Social Science subjects. UTME: English Language, Literature in English, Government/History and any other Arts or Social Science subject. Direct Entry: Two (2) 'A' level passes in Arts or Social Science subjects.

UNIABUJA requires five (5) credit passes at SSCE/GCE O'Level or their equivalent at not more than two (2) sittings to include English Language and Literature-in-English. In addition, candidate must have credit in three other Arts or Social Science subjects including Government/History or Economics. Accepts HND (Lower Credit) in Law related disciplines or ND (Lower Credit) in Law related disciplines (plus six credit passes at not more than two sittings). Two (2) 'A' level passes or three (3) NCE at merit level in Arts or Social Science subjects.

UNICAL requires five (5) 'O' level credit passes at not more than two (2) sittings in WAEC/NECO/NABTEB or equivalent to include English Language, Literature in English and three other Arts or Social Science subjects. Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts/Social Science or ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law.

UNIBEN accepts credit passes in five (5) subjects including English Language and four (4) other subjects from Arts or Social Sciences. Direct Entry: Two (2) A' Level passes including Arts or Social Science subjects. OR ND/HND (Lower Credit) in Law and Related Courses.
